deviation: The 1x cap matches the standard, but the draft makes liability uncapped for wilful misconduct, gross negligence and all clause 11 indemnities. The playbook allows uncapped liability only for fraud, IP infringement indemnity and confidentiality breach, so this exposes Arcadia to unlimited liability for any indemnity it gives. The draft also adds a mutual exclusion of lost profits, revenue and goodwill, which could stop Arcadia recovering its main losses from the supplier. The cap is measured on fees in the 12 months before the claim, which can be low early in the term.
suggested_text: Each party's total aggregate liability arising under this Agreement, whether in contract, tort (including negligence) or otherwise, shall not exceed 1 times the annual fees paid or payable under this Agreement. Nothing in this Agreement limits or excludes either party's liability for (a) fraud; (b) the IP infringement indemnity under clause 11; (c) breach of clause 8 (Confidentiality); or (d) any liability that cannot lawfully be limited or excluded. [Delete the exclusion of indirect and consequential loss, or add: "The exclusion does not apply to losses recoverable under the indemnities or breach of confidentiality, or to costs of cover, data breach remediation or regulatory fines."]
